skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concept of morphemes, types of morphemes, roots, and dependent morphemes.
Learn various techniques for word formation such as affixation, compounding, clipping, conversion, onomatopoeia, and derivation from proper nouns.

Differentiate between lexical meaning and grammatical meaning, direct and indirect meanings, explicit and implicit meanings, polysemy, homophones with different meanings, synonyms, antonyms, metaphor, and metonymy.
Classify vocabulary based on style including common and uncommon vocabulary, formal and informal vocabulary.
Identify and classify fixed phrases, idioms, proverbs, and quotations.
Understand the history of English vocabulary development, loanwords, reasons for borrowing, and assimilation phenomena.
Analyze differences in vocabulary among different variants of English.
Demonstrate active participation in group work, research, and presentations.
Conduct independent research on a specific aspect of lexicology used in real-world contexts.
